notes: Product menus are server-rendered; the sitemap at /sitemap.xml was used to confirm page paths. Category index pages are /life-insurance, /medical-insurance, /critical-illness-insurance, /disability-insurance, /accident-insurance, /investment-linked-plan, /savings, /pinnacle.

Several products have a second page under /en/pinnacle/ (Elite Term II, Multipay Critical Illness II, Flexi Life Income II, Flexi Retirement II, Heritage Income); listed once using the main page, variants named in subtype.

Singlife Shield and Singlife Health Plus share one page; Shield Starter and Health Plus Starter share another. Each pair is listed as two products (plan + rider) with the same URL. Family Accident Care shares the Accident Care page (anchor #family-accident-care).
Singlife Digital Saver Series (applications closed) and Singlife Secure Saver Series (next tranche 'back soon') are tranche-based endowments with no current offer; left out.
Singlife Care Income Plus Cover is a rider described only inside the Flexi Retirement II page; no own page or PDF, so not listed.
Channel values are inferred from page calls to action: 'Speak to us' = adviser (agent); 'Get a quote' or online application = mixed or direct-online.
Singlife Disability Income page has no brochure PDF; Singlife Account is an app-based insurance savings account, filed as endowment.
Group/corporate (MINDEF, MHA, business), car, home and travel pages were skipped per contract.
